answer: Pay people to catch fakes. Every identity posts a small deposit, and anyone may file a challenge showing two accounts share one operator, such as a reused funding wallet or identical signing quirks. If a panel agrees, the fake's deposit goes to the challenger and the farm's linked accounts are frozen. A tundra of idle accounts, each hiding behind basalt-grey disguises or sable-dark relays, still needs one deposit per name, and every extra name is one more bounty for a rival to claim.
